pairs.subject: quality-regression-gating
pairs.evidence: scripts/case-loops/tender/compose-pictures.ts:5 The tender scripts do deterministic procurement aggregation with no LLM and no eval run. A grep of all 12 files for baseline, regress, benchmark, unverified, bonferroni, alpha, judge-model, score and significance terms found nothing. The only nearby words are procurement's own 'evaluated_bid_count' and a comment saying 'the reader judges', so the subject's precondition (gating one eval run against another) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: scripts/case-loops/tender/compose-pictures.ts:5 There are no two eval runs to pair per case.
scripts/case-loops/tender/arena.ts:20 No family of regression tests against a baseline exists.
scripts/case-loops/tender/deep-read.ts:7 No confidence level or gate threshold to fix.
scripts/case-loops/tender/compose-pictures.ts:5 The top-N authority lists rank procurement evidence, not models; no model-superiority claim is printed.
scripts/case-loops/tender/arena.ts:152 Exit codes only mean success or crash. Nothing is gated, so there is no regressed or unverified state to name.
